title: OpenSim 0.1 event (§14, §15, §16)
description: An event is an envelope of type `event` that changes one component of one entity on one timeline. The four state operations are `set`, `merge`, `remove` and `delete`, and there is no fifth: a game action is intent of a profile and is recorded as an event over that profile's components, never as a new operation here. `value` is required by `set` and `merge` (and is what `merge` merges into); a client that does not implement the component's namespace still applies the operation and keeps the rest of the component (§2.3).
